sections.text: The synthetic powertrain project contains TorqueCoordinator, PedalSensor and MotorController. It is a teaching example, not a production AUTOSAR configuration.

Component: PedalSensor | input: RawPedal | output: PedalPosition | period_ms: 10
Component: TorqueCoordinator | input: PedalPosition | output: TorqueRequest | period_ms: 20
Component: MotorController | input: TorqueRequest | output: MotorCurrent | period_ms: 10
Signal: TorqueRequest | producer: TorqueCoordinator | consumer: MotorController | unit: Nm | min: 0 | max: 300
TorqueCoordinator uses a PedalPosition timeout of 100 ms. When a pedal signal is stale, TorqueRequest is set to zero and a diagnostic event is recorded.
